section-title.purpose: Heading above the ledger or a table. Mono, 500, 1.0625rem.

kpi-figure.purpose: Figures strip numbers with tabular numerals; mono. The first cell is larger.

kpi-figure-first.purpose: Instances to check, the widest cell of the strip.

instance-name.purpose: Ledger row name in mono, 500; 600 on warn and crit rows.

body.purpose: Switzer for everything the reader reads, 0.9375rem, line 1.5.

label.purpose: Mono 500 for chips, figure captions, worker header and table headers.

data.purpose: Hostnames, ports, versions, times and error text in Office Code Pro.

cell.purpose: Table cells and alert lines, 0.875rem Switzer.

shadows.name: none-at-rest
shadows.purpose: The system is flat. No elevation shadow exists on any surface, and nothing lifts on hover.

shadows.name: problem-bar
shadows.purpose: 3px inset left bar on a problem instance row in its status fill (warn uses --st-warn). The first figure takes a 3px inset top bar in warn. A border, not a shadow.

shadows.name: current-ring
shadows.purpose: 1px ring on the current menu item.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft 2px ring on a focused form field, with a teal border.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every interactive element, in teal.

motion.name: chevron-turn
motion.purpose: The row chevron turns 180deg when an instance opens. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: pop-in
motion.purpose: Dropdown panels (language, avatar) enter with a 4px slide and fade; the language menu opens upward. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: body-in
motion.purpose: An opened instance body fades in.

motion.name: hover-colour
motion.purpose: Hover and colour transitions on menu items, tabs, dropdown items and buttons; btn:active presses 1px.

motion.name: theme-switch
motion.purpose: Only the knob moves (28px); page colours cross-fade. Layout is identical in both themes.

motion.name: just-changed
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: an instance row whose state changed on live refresh fades from a 22% accent wash. Under reduced motion it keeps a static 1px accent ring instead.

breakpoints.name: full-ledger
breakpoints.purpose: From here every ledger column shows.

breakpoints.name: index-to-top-bar
breakpoints.purpose: Below it the left index becomes a sticky top bar and the ledger header disappears; between 68rem and 80rem version and latency move into the opened row.

breakpoints.name: stack-tables
breakpoints.purpose: Tables that carry actions stack as labelled blocks.

narrative.overview:
Periscope reads like a ledger, not a dashboard of floating cards: one strip of figures, then one table of instances whose columns run straight from the first row to the last. A reader scans down a column to compare and across a row to understand an instance. Every alert is a solid status line inside the instance it belongs to; there is no separate alert feed. Light is the default theme (pale green-tinted ground), dark is a reader choice with the same structure.

The system avoids the look of generated dashboards: floating rounded cards, pill chips, shadows, hover lift, big hero numbers. It keeps what makes a page fast to read: a left index with one drawn icon per page, a small periscope mark, solid status chips with a glyph and a word, and a 3px bar on the left edge of problem rows so the instance to check is visible at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Green-tinted neutral ground, single-level surfaces, 1px seams, 3-4px corners. No shadows, no gradients.
Status as glyph + word on a solid muted fill, identical in both themes. Teal only for action, place and the brand mark.
Switzer for reading, Office Code Pro for data (names, figures, hosts, versions, times).
Problem instances sort first and carry their alerts on the row; every row starts collapsed.
Light and dark themes share one token set (`data-bs-theme`); the page starts light.

rules.name: The Hue Means State Rule
rules.body: Green, ochre, coral and slate are used only for state. Teal is only for interaction and place, and is never used for a status or a badge.

rules.name: The Solid Muted Fill Rule
rules.body: A status is a glyph and a word in the fill's ink on one solid muted fill (--st-*), with 3px corners, the same in both themes. No ring, no tint, never a pill. Problem rows have no tint: only a 3px inset left bar in the status colour.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: A status colour always comes with its glyph shape and a word.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Tables, KPI figures, instance counts and fact values use `tabular-nums` so refreshing numbers do not shift.

rules.name: The One Container Rule
rules.body: A block of related content (the figures, the ledger, a table) is one bordered white surface with 4px corners. Containers are never nested inside each other.

rules.name: The Functional Motion Rule
rules.body: Movement only confirms a state change: chevron turn, dropdown pop-in (0.16s), instance body fade (0.22s), 120ms hover transitions, 1px button press, the theme switch, and one authored moment (.just-changed, 2.2s accent wash on a row changed by live refresh). No hover lift, no dimming of siblings, no decorative entrance animation. Reduced motion removes movement and keeps a static accent ring on the changed row.

dos: Do align every repeated value in a shared grid so columns run straight from row to row.
Do carry state with a glyph, a word and a solid status fill, and nothing else.
Do keep teal for action, place and the brand mark only: links, the primary button, the current page icon, focus.
Do use mono only for data (names, figures, hosts, versions, times) and Switzer for everything the reader reads.
Do keep a 2.75rem minimum height on menu items, tabs and the language dropdown and a visible 2px focus outline with 2px offset.
Do keep destructive actions at least 1.25rem from any neighbouring control and behind a confirmation.
donts: Don't nest containers, or use rounded pills (the theme switch track is the single exception), shadows, hover lift, sibling dimming or decorative entrance animation.
Don't use teal for a status, or green, amber or coral for interaction.

Don't use an eyebrow, a decorative icon outside the page icons and the brand mark, or a tinted instance row. The 3px inset bar on problem rows and the top bar on the first figure are the only edge marks.
Don't copy HyperOtter's palette or mascot; only its sans-plus-mono logic is shared.
